name: spec-plan-oracle
description: Read-only product workflow: write a testable spec, plan the smallest safe implementation slice, then oracle-review the plan.

steps.task: Convert goal into a testable spec for: {goal}. Preserve original ask: {original_user_ask}. Do not plan implementation beyond handoff criteria.
steps.expectedOutcome: spec.v1 with acceptance criteria and planner handoff
steps.context: Chain {chain}, step {step_id}; original ask: {original_user_ask}; previous steps: {previous_step_ids}

steps.task: Plan the smallest safe implementation slice for goal: {goal}, using the spec from previous steps: {previous_step_ids}. Produce validation ladder and stop conditions only.
steps.expectedOutcome: Bounded implementation plan with validation ladder and risks
steps.context: Chain {chain}, step {step_id}; original ask: {original_user_ask}; previous steps: {previous_step_ids}

steps.task: Review the spec-derived plan for goal: {goal}. Return PASS/FAIL/WARN and no_ship without editing.
steps.expectedOutcome: Oracle verdict on whether the plan is safe and sufficiently specified
mustDo: Check plan against spec acceptance criteria
Flag missing validation or unsafe scope
